note: The operations the organization ledger writer (.github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml, job ledger-ingest) runs from the committed ingest request beside this file. The job is selected by control/workflow-surface-registry.json writer_jobs[] (paths .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/**); the operation is read from the request by resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py. Same manifest as StegVerse-Labs/.github, which runs sv_check_receipt as well; this organization declares the two it runs.

organization_ledger_writer_operations.append_path: resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py::append under the store's exclusive section (source bound by resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py::sealed_source)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_location: the producer's sealed receipt unchanged at source-receipts/<receipt_sha256>.json, consumed by one organization receipt whose source_transition_sha256 is that receipt_sha256
organization_ledger_writer_operations.admission: .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/accepted-sealed-receipts.json kinds only; seal over the canonical body; ALLOW, no refusals, tests >= 1 and skipped/failed/errors 0; ledger_candidate.target this organization's ledger; request provenance names the producer repository, head and run; any failure -> six-field FAIL_CLOSED before any write
organization_ledger_writer_operations.invoked_by: .github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml job ledger-ingest (push to main touching .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/** with request operation sealed_test_receipt; ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK); no dispatch input, no schedule
organization_ledger_writer_operations.hb_reference: the supplied epoch the ledger head carries (merge_transfer.head_epoch); no clock
organization_ledger_writer_operations.readback: resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py readback-sealed on a fresh fetch of the published ref

organization_ledger_writer_operations.append_path: resident-runtime/sv_push_receipt_append.py::_append_one (the range lookup, then repository ledger .stegverse/transition-ledger/emit.py::append, then resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py::append, the two-level append resident-runtime/merge_transfer.py uses; intr_destination_ingress.py and aggregate_repo_transition.py unedited)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_schema_file: schemas/sv-push-receipt.v1.schema.json (emitted by resident-runtime/sv_push_receipt.py; the shape and seal check is that module's receipt_problem)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_location: repository receipt $.evidence (the complete push receipt, self-identified by $.evidence.schema), retained beside the organization receipt at source-receipts/<hex>.json
organization_ledger_writer_operations.ledger_ownership: a push receipt is recorded on the ledger of the organization that owns the pushed repository (Coordination ruling, StegVerse-org/.github#167); this ledger records receipts for StegVerse-org repositories, and each organization keeps its own ledger
organization_ledger_writer_operations.invoked_by: .github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml job ledger-ingest (push to main touching .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/request.json with operation sv_push_receipt, read by resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py; ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK); no dispatch input, no schedule
organization_ledger_writer_operations.one_receipt_per_range: the range is (repository, ref, old_sha, new_sha); the repository transition id is SV_PUSH_RECEIPT_APPEND:<sha256 of that range>, so one range has one receipt; a second receipt for a range the ledger already records, byte-identical or not, -> six-field FAIL_CLOSED SV_PUSH_RECEIPT_RANGE_ALREADY_RECORDED, nothing appended; one request carries one receipt, one request PR per receipt (batching needs a documented change proposal)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.admission: one object whose schema is stegverse.sv_push_receipt.v1 that passes sv_push_receipt.receipt_problem (closed field set, 40-hex shas, pushed_commits ending at new_sha, supplied hb_epoch, result_sha256 seal); LEDGER_EVIDENCE_NOT_A_PUSH_RECEIPT or SV_PUSH_RECEIPT_MALFORMED otherwise, six fields, before any write
organization_ledger_writer_operations.hb_reference: supplied epoch only, from the committed ingest request (integer >= 32) and equal to the receipt's own hb_epoch; derived_from_clock false or the operation fails closed
organization_ledger_writer_operations.epoch_rule: resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py::supplied_epoch_failure (byte-identical to resident-runtime/organization_egress_boundary.py::supplied_epoch_failure), source sha256 pinned as epoch_rule_sha256
organization_ledger_writer_operations.epoch_tie: append epoch or receipt hb_epoch (both epoch-source fields) absent, null, "", "null" or UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHENTICALLY_OBSERVED -> FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED; any other malformed value or a differing value -> DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH; a stored hb_reference that is unsealed or clock-derived -> FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED
organization_ledger_writer_operations.readback: resident-runtime/sv_push_receipt_append.py readback on a fresh fetch of the published ref (sealed pair, linked, valid evidence, exactly one receipt for the range)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.verifier: clock-free and network-free: reads the committed request, the receipt and the declared ledger store only
